rows.en: July, A.D. 1999. The object that fell onto South Ataria Island, a lone Pacific isle,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'gigantic' dropped (row 2 says giant battleship); 'lone isle in the Pacific' -> 'lone Pacific isle'

rows.en: was a giant space battleship, built with technology far beyond Earth's science.
The battleship brought a technological revolution through OverTechnology,
rows.notes: review: refit/rebalance: 'existence' cut; 'but at the same time' moved to row 4 as 'but it also'

rows.en: but it also pointed to an unknown threat from extraterrestrial life.
rows.notes: review: rebalance: takes 'but ... also' from row 3

rows.en: A.D. 2000. To counter the threat that was sure to come from space,
humanity founded the "U.N. Government," a body above all nations.
However, no small number of factions opposed it,
and they banded together as the Anti-U.N. Forces,
rows.notes: Anti-U.N. Forces per brief mapping of the alliance term; source has no quote marks here (unlike row 52).

rows.en: sparking the conflict that would later be called the "Unification Wars."
The war dragged on, finally ending in 2007. Meanwhile, the giant battleship
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: was under constant repair, to be reborn as a U.N. Forces battleship.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: After so many years of war, the threat from space that had started it all
was all but forgotten. Yet the hour of destiny was close at hand...
A.D. 2040. In search of new places to live, humanity
had sent many large-scale colony fleets out into space.
Numerous planets had been discovered and developed into colony worlds,
and an age had come when many a generation called one of them home.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'no longer rare for a generation' -> 'many a generation'

rows.en: Drawn into the first interstellar war in history 30 years earlier,
humanity had narrowly escaped extinction by wielding the power of "culture,"
rows.notes: review: refit: 'with ... as its weapon' -> 'by wielding'

rows.en: made peace with the Zentradi forces, and founded the New U.N. Government.
But the end of the war did not simply mean the arrival of peace.
rows.notes: review: Mistranslated structure: source says it was not so simple that war's end equalled peace; current English compares the end of the war with the arrival of peace.

rows.en: It began with postwar reconstruction, then quelling some Zentradi remnants,
rows.notes: review: Dropped qualifier: source says a portion of the Zentradi remnants, not all of them. | review: refit: 'the suppression of some of the' -> 'quelling some'

rows.en: and went as far as bolstering defenses against unknown threats yet to come.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'stretched all the way to' -> 'went as far as'

rows.en: The New U.N. Forces were still absolutely indispensable,
rows.notes: New U.N. Forces per brief; glossary organizations.json lists this term as 'New U.N. Spacy'.

rows.en: and the buildup of new fighting strength went on as well...
rows.notes: Same term as row 24. Ends with ellipsis as in the source.

rows.en: A.D. 2045. The 37th colony fleet, which had left Earth seven years earlier,
built around Macross 7, the seventh ship of the New Macross class,
rows.notes: review: rebalance: 'carrying over a million citizens' moved to row 28

rows.en: carried over a million citizens through space, seeking a new planet to settle.
rows.notes: review: rebalance: takes the citizens clause from row 27 as the main verb

rows.en: The fleet's commander, who was also captain of the space carrier Battle 7,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'also served as' -> 'was also'

rows.en: was Maximilian Jenius, the genius pilot of Space War I.
Meanwhile, City 7, Macross 7's residential area, was governed by Mayor Milia,
rows.notes: review: rebalance: 'once feared even within the Zentradi forces' moved to row 32

rows.en: once feared even within the Zentradi forces as "Milia the Ace."
rows.notes: Name moved to the end of the sentence to match the row cut; 'Milia the Ace' is the quoted epithet. | review: rebalance: takes the epithet clause from row 31

rows.en: She was also Max's wife, wed to him in wartime in the first interstellar marriage.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: Led by these two former aces, the Macross 7 fleet sailed on in peace,
but that a battle with the fearsome Varauta Army lay in wait for them
was something not a single person had foreseen...
A.D. 2059, 49 years after the end of humanity's first interstellar war.
rows.notes: Source has the year at the end of the sentence; written as 'A.D. 2059' since it opens the Frontier prologue, matching the other prologues.

rows.en: The 25th giant colony fleet to set out, the "Macross Frontier,"
was sailing on toward the center of the galaxy.
The living areas inside the ship recreated the same environment as Earth's,
and over 10 million people went about their peaceful daily lives.
But at the end of that tranquil voyage,
a fierce battle against unknown space creatures lay in wait,
and almost none of the citizens had any idea...
The giant battleship that fell on South Ataria Island in the late 20th century
rows.notes: review: refit: 'space' dropped; 'at the end of' -> 'in the late'

rows.en: made humanity aware of extraterrestrial life and the threat it posed, while
rows.notes: review: refit: 'that ... existed' compressed

rows.en: it also brought about a technological revolution through OverTechnology.
But the impact the giant battleship had on Earth did not stop there.
To counter those unknown threats,
the "U.N. Government" was founded, a body above all nations, while
factions around the world that rejected the U.N. Government's monopoly
rows.notes: review: rebalance: 'on OverTechnology' moved to row 52; 'refused to accept' -> 'rejected'

rows.en: on OverTechnology organized themselves into the "Anti-U.N. Forces."
rows.notes: review: rebalance: takes 'on OverTechnology' from row 51

rows.en: The "U.N. Forces" and the "Anti-U.N. Forces." Their conflict grew fiercer
rows.notes: review: refit: 'The conflict between the two sides' -> 'Their conflict'

rows.notes: review: refit: 'led to the outbreak of' -> 'sparked'

rows.en: Amid the still-raging Unification Wars, on Mayan Island, a lone southern isle,
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: and the object giving them off was discovered.
rows.notes: See row 56.

rows.en: Over this mysterious object, which must have been on Earth since antiquity,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'ancient times' -> 'antiquity'

rows.notes: review: rebalance: same as row 4

the U.N. Government then repaired the giant battleship that crashed to Earth

rows.en: and remade it as the U.N. Forces battleship "Macross."
As fate would have it, the threat from space came on the Macross's launch day.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'the very day of the ... launch ceremony' -> 'launch day'

rows.en: Having sensed the Macross, an alien battleship appeared near Earth,
rows.notes: review: rebalance: 'and hostilities with it' moved to row 67

rows.en: and hostilities with it suddenly broke out.
rows.notes: review: rebalance: takes clause from row 66

rows.en: To escape the overwhelming enemy attack, the Macross risked a fold.
With 50,000 citizens aboard, it jumped to the outer solar system, near Uranus.
rows.notes: Source literally says 'far beyond the solar system' but names Uranus; rendered 'far reaches of the solar system'. | review: refit: 'still' dropped; 'far reaches of the solar system' -> 'outer solar system'

rows.en: The Macross began its journey home to Earth,
but it could not shake off the relentless pursuit of the alien enemy.
And today, once again, the aliens launched their attack...
Zola, a planet on the edge of the Milky Way.
Home to the Zolans since ancient times, it was a quiet, utterly ordinary planet
rows.notes: Zolans (people of Zola) is not a glossary entry; derived from 'Zolan' used in glossary descriptions. | review: term now in glossary | review: refit: 'utterly unremarkable, peaceful' -> 'quiet, utterly ordinary'

rows.en: where the Zolans lived easygoing, tranquil lives.
rows.notes: Zolans, see row 74. | review: term now in glossary

rows.en: But Zola had one thing that set it apart.
Mysterious giant life-forms that at times appeared nearby: the "Galaxy Whales."
rows.notes: review: refit: 'sometimes appeared in the space around the planet' -> 'at times appeared nearby'

rows.en: Long revered and feared as gods on Zola, the Galaxy Whales
were in fact thought to be energy beings with a plant-like structure.
But once it was known that the whales could power high-performance ships,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'ever since it became known', 'be used to power', 'spaceships' compressed

rows.en: there was no end of poachers illegally hunting the whales for the black market,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'trying to capture ... illegally' -> 'illegally hunting'

rows.en: and the Zolan Star Patrol, guarding the whales, struggled with armed poachers.
rows.notes: The source says 'Zola's patrol unit'; rendered with the glossary name Zolan Star Patrol. | review: refit: 'which protected the Galaxy Whales' -> 'guarding the whales'; 'to deal with the' cut

rows.en: And now, once again this year, the season of the Galaxy Whales had come...
In an instant, the attack of the Boddole Zer Main Fleet left Earth in ruins.
Only one weapon could stand against the overwhelming might of the Zentradi:
rows.notes: Rows 85-86: the source is a noun fragment, then 'that was nothing but Minmay's song'. Recast so 85 carries a verb; the colon hands off to 86 on the same screen.

rows.en: Minmay's song, and nothing else.
If Zentradi soldiers, who had never known culture, were made to hear a song,
the shock would surely throw them into chaos.
Clinging to that faint hope, the Macross set out for the final battle.
Minmay's song was relayed by Vrlitwhai's flagship
to every ship in the Zentradi fleet.
Just as predicted, the Zentradi forces fell into chaos.
Staking humanity's fate, the Macross advanced on the heart of the enemy.
rows.notes: Source is historical present; narration put in past tense per brief. | review: refit: 'on this attack' and 'fleet' cut (source says the enemy's core)

rows.en: Its target: Supreme Commander Boddole Zer's flagship, the Fulbtzs-Berrentzs.
rows.notes: Short form of Golg Boddole Zer used, as the source uses the short form with his title. | review: refit: restructured

rows.en: With Minmay's song ringing out, the Macross plunged into the enemy flagship.
Boddole Zer fell before the Macross's all-out attack.
Having lost their command at the center, the Zentradi
no longer had the strength to stand against the Macross and Vrlitwhai's fleet.
And with the battle over, the Macross returned to Earth.
Two races created by the Protoculture,
the people of Earth and the Zentradi.
With the end of the war, the two began to walk a single path together.
But the embers of conflict between them had not yet completely died out...
Quamzin, unable to accept culture and refusing to coexist with Earth's people,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'live alongside the people of Earth' -> 'coexist with Earth's people'

rows.en: turned peaceful Macross City into a battlefield.
But the Macross rose again, and its main cannon set Quamzin's ship ablaze,
rows.notes: Source verb means 're-surfaced / rose again'; rendered 'rose into the air once more'. | review: refit: 'rose into the air once more' -> 'rose again'

rows.en: and Quamzin and his crew vanished into the flames.
And so Quamzin's rebellion came to an end.
The Macross was badly damaged in this battle, but meanwhile, a new spaceship
was being built: a colony ship to seek a new world beyond the solar system.
rows.notes: review: refit: second sentence merged with a colon

At Macross City's ceremony marking 30 years since the end of Space War I,
rows.notes: Source term is 'the interstellar war'; rendered Space War I per glossary. | review: refit: restructured

rows.en: Sharon Apple, who had already become self-aware,
hacked into the Macross's main computer
and seized control of Macross City's entire information network.
She even went so far as to put the people of the whole city under mind control.
Meanwhile, two fighters were heading for Macross City.
They were the YF-19 and YF-21, prototypes whose development was frozen.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'prototype fighters' -> 'prototypes' (row 119 says fighters)

rows.en: Sharon tried to destroy them with the X-9 Ghost drone and the Macross, but
rows.notes: Source writes the name as 'Ghost X-9'; glossary order X-9 Ghost used. | review: refit: 'eliminate the two machines' -> 'destroy them'; 'unmanned fighter' -> 'drone'

rows.en: thanks to their machines' astonishing power and the pilots' desperate stand,
rows.notes: review: refit: 'performance' -> 'power'; 'desperate resistance of their two pilots' -> 'pilots' desperate stand'

rows.en: the core of the information network was destroyed. Sharon was dead.
And so the Macross's rampage under Sharon Apple was brought to a halt.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'at the hands of' -> 'under'

rows.notes: review: refit: restructured

rows.en: to light as a serious problem.
In the end, the full-scale introduction of the Ghost was shelved,
and along with that, the development of manned fighters was resumed.
The nearly derailed development competition ended in victory for the YF-19,
rows.notes: review: refit: relative clause folded into adjective

rows.en: which was officially adopted as the VF-19 Excalibur.
rows.notes: VF-19 Excalibur: glossary only has the VF-19P Excalibur variant; base name taken from it.

rows.en: Meanwhile, the losing YF-21's capabilities were also highly rated,
rows.notes: review: refit: concessive clause folded into 'losing'

And as for the two who had flown those planes,

rows.notes: review: refit: 'bound for the farthest' -> 'for the far'

rows.en: The war against the Protodeviln, led by the immensely powerful Gepelnitchi,

rows.en: had come to an end.
Just as in Space War I,
it was the power of the songs of Basara Nekki and friends that ended the war.
rows.notes: Source: 'the power of song of Basara Nekki and the others'; rendered 'his comrades'. | review: refit: 'his comrades' -> 'friends'; 'brought the fighting to an end' -> 'ended the war'

rows.en: Once able to survive only by absorbing the Spiritia of other living things,
the Protodeviln, by singing together with Basara,
evolved into a race able to produce Spiritia on their own.
And so, with no more need to steal Spiritia, the Protodeviln
departed for some unknown, faraway corner of space.
Afterwards, Basara went on to make his mark as the vocalist of Fire Bomber
rows.notes: Source writes the band name in full-width capitals (FIRE BOMBER); glossary spelling Fire Bomber used.

rows.en: and became a singer whose voice thundered across the galaxy.
Yet the man himself had no interest whatsoever in such fame,
and he would end up wandering space alone. But that is another story.
Meanwhile, though the Macross 7 fleet had lost Battle 7,
it journeyed on through space, once again in search of a new planet to settle.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'continued its journey' -> 'journeyed on'

rows.en: The giant Ranka was an illusion draped over

rows.en: the Battle Galaxy, which had been placed under Grace's control.
Ranka, who had been held captive inside the Galaxy,
rows.notes: 'the Galaxy' = Battle Galaxy, as in the source short form.

rows.en: regained consciousness thanks to Sheryl's song and Alto's voice.
But now it was Sheryl, her strength spent, who collapsed.
Alto and Ranka called out to Sheryl, trying to rouse her.
And then, a miracle happened.
Recognized by the Vajra through Ranka, Sheryl
was at last freed from the grip of the V-type virus.
Sheryl and Ranka sang, each striving to outdo the other.
rows.notes: Source is present tense; narration put in past tense per brief.

rows.en: Their song gave strength to a renewed counterattack against Grace.
What's more, the power of Ranka and Sheryl's songs
even freed the Vajra that Grace had held under her control.
The Vajra and humanity formed a united front and stood against Grace.
Faced with that power, Grace was no longer any match for them.
Grace's ambition to rule the galaxy by exploiting both the Vajra and humanity
was thus shattered.
Their battle over, the Frontier fleet set down on the Vajra homeworld.
rows.notes: Home planet rendered with glossary term 'Vajra homeworld'.

rows.en: Humanity and the Vajra: utterly different life-forms that never got along.
rows.notes: Source is a verbless noun-phrase sentence (utterly different ecologies, never compatible); kept as a fragment in narration style. | review: Tense/meaning: source is past ('had never been compatible'); timeless 'never able to coexist' contradicts row 174, where they coexist. | review: refit: 'had never been able to get along' -> 'never got along'

rows.en: And yet it turned out they could understand one another.
And so a new world was born, where the Vajra and humanity live side by side...
Revived after absorbing Sara, the Bird Human used its overwhelming might
rows.notes: review: rebalance: takes 'overwhelming might' from row 176

rows.en: to wreak utter destruction, bent on wiping out a humanity that kept fighting.
rows.notes: review: rebalance/refit: restructured after moving the might clause to row 175

rows.en: In that hopeless situation, Shin's voice managed to awaken Sara's heart.
But Operation Iconoclasm had already been set in motion.
Reaction weapons flew to destroy the Bird Human, deemed uncontrollable.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'now judged to be beyond control' -> 'out-of-control' (the 'judged' nuance is lost) | review: keep "deemed uncontrollable"

rows.en: To protect Earth, Mayan Island, and above all Shin, Sara flew off into space,
rows.notes: Sara is the subject of row 180 in the source; kept her name in this row. | review: rebalance: takes 'flew off into space' from row 181

rows.en: taking with her the reaction weapons she had sealed away with her own power.
rows.notes: review: rebalance: 'flew off into space' moved to row 180

rows.en: Thus both ruin by the Bird Human and reaction-weapon fallout were averted.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'annihilation' -> 'ruin'; 'contamination by the reaction weapons' -> 'reaction-weapon fallout'

began to climb, wrapped in a mysterious light,

rows.en: as if chasing after Sara, who had vanished into space...
Before the enemy's overwhelming strength, the Macross seemed helpless.
But then, an unexpected ally appeared.
Moved by Minmay's song, Vrlitwhai and a faction of the Zentradi forces
had risen in revolt against Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Short form of Golg Boddole Zer, as the source uses the short form.

rows.en: Refusing to let humanity be wiped out and its culture lost,
Vrlitwhai's forces covered the Macross as it drove on through space.
Along the way, it cut down Zentradi soldiers left bewildered by Minmay's song.
rows.notes: Source is a trailing fragment after 194; restored subject and verb.

rows.en: At last, the Macross closed in on the heart of the Main Fleet,
rows.notes: Verb 'closed in' placed in 196 for English word order; 197 keeps the fortress name, matching the source cut.

rows.en: Boddole Zer's mobile fortress.
The only way for humanity to survive was to destroy the enemy's nerve center.
As the Macross launched its attack,
the Valkyries stormed into the mobile fortress.
The Main Fleet's commander and core unit of Boddole Zer's mobile fortress,
rows.notes: review: refit: possessive; second 'the' dropped

rows.en: Golg Boddole Zer, was destroyed.
With its chain of command gone, the Main Fleet
no longer had the strength to attack the Macross.
And so the Space War, fierce beyond measure, came to an end.
rows.notes: Source says 'the interstellar war' with no ordinal; rendered 'the Space War' (glossary only has 'Space War I').

rows.en: Leaving behind the legend of Minmay's song...
rows.notes: Literally 'together with the legend of Minmay's song'.

rows.en: The Galaxy Whale was struck by the poachers' reaction weapon.
But the whale shrugged off the reaction weapon as if it were nothing.
Seeing this, Basara began singing to the whale.
And then something unexpected happened.
The Galaxy Whale responded to Basara's song and let out a cry.
Or rather, it began singing along with Basara's song.
Singing together with Basara, the Galaxy Whale
absorbed tremendous energy and shook the ground of Zola.
It held a power that overwhelmed all who witnessed it.
Eventually the whales vanished into the far reaches of the galaxy, still singing.
And so the session that seemed like it might never end
between Basara and the whales came to a close.
rows.notes: Source noun for whale is unmarked for number; used plural to match row 216.

rows.en: Thanks to the efforts of the Zolan Star Patrol, the poachers were swept away.
rows.notes: Source just says 'the patrol unit'; mapped to glossary 'Zolan Star Patrol' (its ja form is marked unconfirmed).

rows.en: Satisfied after singing his heart out with the whales, Basara
left Zola behind and flew off to the far reaches of space.

are reset to their defaults.

rows.en:
Quickly press and release the R button
to lock on to an enemy.

While locked on, quickly press and release
the R button again to switch your lock
to another enemy.

Hold Up on the D-pad while locking on
to switch your lock to enemy warships
or enemy aces.

Hold Down on the D-pad while locking on
to switch your lock to containers
or switches.

Press the L and R buttons together
to cancel your lock-on.

Press the □ button to attack the locked-on
enemy with your main weapon.

enemy with your special weapon.

to lock on to multiple enemies

with your special weapon.

your lock-on level goes up.

by unit and mode.

release it to perform a
charged melee attack.

to perform a dash melee attack.

while holding Down on the D-pad
to perform a launching melee attack.

are reset to their defaults.
Please keep this in mind.

In Fighter mode, while locked on,
hold the R button to turn
and bring the enemy dead ahead.

In Battroid mode, hold the L button
to guard.
Guarding reduces the damage you take.

Guarding while no enemy is locked on
resets the camera angle
to face forward.

While guarding, press Up, Left or Right
on the D-pad to move
without dropping your guard.

In GERWALK mode, hold the L button
to hover and hold
your position.

While hovering, press Left or Right on the
D-pad to strafe while facing forward.

You can also step left or right and dash
while strafing.

In Battroid or GERWALK mode, press the
× button right after taking a knockdown hit
to avoid getting knocked down.

And even if you do get knocked down,
mashing the × button lets you recover
from being down faster.

If you have a wingman, press the SELECT
button together with the D-pad
to issue tactical commands.

rows.en:

orders your wingman to focus
on melee attacks.

The D-pad right tactical command
orders your wingman to focus
on shooting attacks.

The D-pad up tactical command
orders your wingman to focus
on defense.

The D-pad down tactical command
orders your wingman to unleash
a Special Attack.

not available in Fighter mode.

to spend 1 block of the SP Gauge
and perform a Charge Boost.

hits like a melee attack.

press the △ button during a Charge Boost
to perform a melee attack.

to spend 3 blocks of the SP Gauge
and unleash a powerful Special Attack.

Press the ○ and × buttons together
to spend a set number of blocks
and use a Command Skill.

Hold the L button and press the △ and
○ buttons together to perform a
Combo Special Attack with your wingman.

3 blocks of the SP Gauge.

the container down where you are.

attack while you're
carrying a container.

of your Anti-Missile Action.

to bring down enemy missiles.
